<abbr title="Koh-Lanta: All Stars">'''''Koh-Lanta: All Stars'''''</abbr> is the eighth special season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'' and the thirty-fourth season overall. It was announced on June 18, 2026 and started airing on August 25, 2026.

==Twists/Changes==
* '''[[Returning Players/Koh-Lanta|All Stars]]:''' Eighteen former ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'' castaways return for another chance at the [[Sole Survivor]] title.
* '''[[Tied Destinies]]:''' Similarly to the Tied Destinies twist that usually happens after the merge, the castaways will be partnered from the first episode with one castaway from one of their former season, giving them a one in nine chance of exiting the game during the first cycle.
* '''[[One World (twist)|One World]] Format:''' Before the tribes were made, all 18 castaways were marooned on the same island and spent the first part of the game together there.
* '''[[Redemption Island (international twist)|Isle of the Banished]]:''' After departing Tribal Council, the voted out castaways are taken to the Isle of the Banished, a small island with little resources. Before the tribe switch, they will compete in a challenge after which two will re-enter the game. <ref>https://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/tele-realite/ugo-tania-freddy-lola-moussa-decouvrez-les-18-candidats-de-l-edition-all-stars-des-25-ans-de-koh-lanta-20260618</ref>
* '''[[Tribe Switch]]:'''
